case_title: ANGELICA CURIEL VS. GARNETH JEAN ROSARIO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY CURIEL, ANGELICA AS TO DEFENDANT ROSARIO, GARNETH JEAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-17-2021 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$100.00) SERVED NOV-03-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT ROSARIO, GARNETH JEAN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-17-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAR-11-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANGELICA CURIEL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GARNETH JEAN ROSARIO IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $2050 (COSTS INCLUDED) TO THE PLAINTIFF BY A 10-MONTH PAYMENT PLAN. THE FIRST PAYMENT OF $205 IS DUE ON DEC-07-2021, WITH SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS DUE ON THE 7TH OF EACH MONTH UNTIL THE RESOLVE DATE OF OCT-7-2022. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED NOT TO TALK WITH ANYONE AT WORK ABOUT THIS CASE OR THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAR-11-2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE, OR THE AGREEMENT IS BROKEN, AND A JUDGEMENT WILL BE RENDERED AT THAT TIME. PROGRESS REPORTS SHALL BE DONE IN FOUR-MONTH INTERVALS. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
